subject: summary of gm.prcomp no longer working?

messages.author: 62a7fe14c0ce6d79
messages.subject: summary of gm.prcomp no longer working?
parts:
Hi
After updating to the latest version of geomorph, making an object from the summary function for a gm.prcomp object no longer seems to be working

I used to run something like the following to extract the proportion of variance explained by each principal component:

coords.prcomp <- gm.prcomp(coords)
pca.ev <- summary(coords.prcomp)
pca.ev <- pca.ev$tips[2,] 

Now pca.ev gives NULL

Not sure why. I am running the latest version of R and all packages.

messages.author: 4d71c6e24fb21497
messages.subject: RE: [geomorph-r-package] summary of gm.prcomp no longer working?
parts:
Faysal,

 

The summary function for gm.prcomp works fine; just not when dumped into an object (see help file example, which is repeated below).  Also, if one wishes to generate the components in the summary object, they are available within the gm.prcomp object (again see code below).

 

Dean

 

###

data(plethspecies)

Y.gpa <- gpagen(plethspecies$land)    #GPA-alignment

 

###  Traditional PCA

PCA <- gm.prcomp(Y.gpa$coords)

summary(PCA)

 

#Components in gm.prcomp object

PCA$sdev^2  #here are eigenvalues

PCA$sdev^2/sum(PCA$sdev^2)  #and as a proportion of total variance

messages.author: aab55242ff4da6c6
messages.subject: Re: [geomorph-r-package] summary of gm.prcomp no longer working?
parts:
Faysal,

The gm.prcomp function now uses the ordinate function in RRPP (before it didn’t) and there currently is no print.summary.ordinate function to call, to make the naming of a summary object possible.  I’ll look into whether this is easy enough to add as a function before the next RRPP update.  No guarantees that it will make sense to do though.

Mike
